name: Advice
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital importance of seeking and heeding godly advice as a foundation for wisdom and safety. Proverbs teaches that true knowledge begins with the fear of the LORD and warns against relying solely on one’s own understanding. Wise counsel provides protection and guidance, contrasting with the folly of those who reject instruction or trust only their own perspective. Furthermore, receiving and embracing counsel leads to wisdom in the latter days, highlighting the value of both giving and receiving advice under the Lord’s authority.
